# Scrub

> Scrub is a native macOS app uninstaller that removes apps completely, including leftover caches, containers, preferences, launch agents, helpers, and related files.

## Product

- [Homepage](https://scrubmac.app/): Product overview, screenshots, privacy notes, requirements, FAQ, and download.
- [Download DMG](https://scrubmac.app/Scrub.dmg): Current Scrub installer for macOS.
- [Releases](https://scrubmac.app/releases): Current Scrub version and launch download details.
- [Privacy](https://scrubmac.app/privacy): Privacy details for the site and native app.
- [Terms](https://scrubmac.app/terms): Terms for downloading and using Scrub.
- [Full LLM context](https://scrubmac.app/llms-full.txt): Extended product, privacy, safety, and support details.

## Key Facts

- Product: Scrub for macOS.
- Category: macOS utility / app uninstaller.
- Platform: macOS 14 or later.
- Price: Free.
- Distribution: direct DMG download, Developer ID signed and Apple notarized.
- Current version: 1.5.
- Core feature: removes an app bundle plus related Application Support, caches, preferences, containers, launch agents, daemons, helpers, and login items.
- Leftovers feature: finds files left behind by apps already deleted and skips Apple system files.
- Safety: sends files to Trash first, supports review before removal, and avoids system-critical paths.
- Privacy: scanning and cleanup happen on the user's Mac; Scrub does not read or upload what the user chooses to delete.
- Not affiliated with Apple.
